description: Render any public web page in a real Chrome browser and return a PNG screenshot. Use when you need to see how a page looks, check a layout, capture visual evidence, or read content that only appears after JavaScript runs. Options: width 320-2560 (default 1280), full=true for the whole page. Errors: 400 bad or private URL, 504 page took over 30s. Price: $0.01 USDC per call (x402).
name: screenshot_webpage
title: Web page screenshot
